name: Hinoemata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hinoemata village emblem in red: a stylised device of a ring with two pointed ears and a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Hinoemata, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in November 1972.

features.role: Hinoemata village emblem — a stylised device of a ring with two pointed ears and a vertical bar
